checkIn.description: Handles user check-in and task planning.

cancelPlanTasks.description: Skips task planning and goes to working state.

saveAllTasks.description: Validates and saves the user's daily task plan.

startBreak.description: Registers the start of a break.

endBreak.description: Registers the end of a break.

submitReview.description: Processes final task reviews and logs the checkout time.
